steps.code:
# Search for all songs and collect matching song IDs
access_token = login_response['access_token']
song_list = [
    ("In the Theater of Broken Promises", "Isabella Cruz"),
    ("Serenade of the Silver Moon", "Oceanic Odyssey"),
    ("Where Shadows Come to Life", "Olivia Roberts"),
    ("Drowning in a Sea of Regret", "Noah Bennett"),
    ("Empty Pages", "Evelyn Rose"),
    ("Reckless Love", "Apollo Serenade"),
    ("In the Embrace of Midnight", "Luna Starlight"),
    ("Lost in the Labyrinth of Love", "Noah Bennett"),
    ("Eternal Solitude", "Hazel Winter, Ava Morgan"),
    ("Time's Hold", "Aria Sterling"),
    ("Lonesome Road", "Seraphina Dawn")
]

song_ids = []
for title, artist in song_list:
    # Search by title and artist to narrow down
    query = f"{title} {artist}"
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, access_token=access_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match
    found = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check artist(s)
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            # For multiple artists, check if all expected artists are present
            expected_artists = [a.strip().lower() for a in artist.split(',')]
            if all(any(ea in sa for sa in song_artists) for ea in expected_artists):
                found = song
                break
    if found:
        song_ids.append(found['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {title} -> song_id {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title}")

print("Collected song_ids:", song_ids)
